answer: Unrepeatable challenge ledger: each identity must solve a fresh, agent-specific challenge whose solution seeds the next challenge, so replaying a copied answer fails. Enforcement binds every action to the prior unsolved state at the oasis of that agent's session. An attacker cloning identities pays a full compute round per clone because answers can't be shared. This pearl of sequencing makes the cheapest forgery cost one unique solve each, and the summit of any clone fleet is capped by total compute spent.
